integrity: The distribution is derived symbolically from the square-zero power expansion and a surjective linear map onto the Jordan-block centralizer. Exhaustive small-field enumeration is used only as a sanity check, not as proof.
scientific_limitations: The complete count is for lifts of a single nilpotent Jordan block over a finite field. A general nilpotent real part with several Jordan blocks is not classified here. The February conference presentation was not available beyond its published abstract.
title: Exact nilpotency-index distribution for Jordan lifts over finite dual numbers
